name: Luis De Jesus Los Angeles
about_text: Luis De Jesus Los Angeles is a contemporary art gallery founded in 2007 in San Diego by partners Luis De Jesus and Jay Wingate under the name Luis De Jesus Seminal Projects. The gallery relocated to Santa Monica in 2010, rebranding as Luis De Jesus Los Angeles, then moved to the Culver City Arts District in 2011, where it operated for a decade. Since spring 2021 it has occupied an expansive space on the edge of downtown Los Angeles's Arts District. The gallery represents a diverse roster of artists whose work engages personal, social, cultural, and aesthetic concerns, with many receiving major awards, biennial invitations, and museum acquisitions.
program_focus: identity, race, and social justice themes

triage.site_notes: The gallery organizes its site around a single /artists roster page (thin, but the canonical index), a combined /exhibitions listing that mixes current and past shows (each show also has its own exhibition_page not separately labelled here), a large /art-fairs section with dozens of individual fair pages, and a sprawling /news-press aggregator plus dozens of individual press-release URLs; no dedicated 'about' or 'history' page was found in the inventory despite being a standard nav item.
